title: NotificationService fails processing ManualInteractionRequiredEvent when Episode cannot be determined
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this? - [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues ### Current Behavior **Given** a downloaded episode that cannot be automatically imported due to "Invalid season or episode" **When** `ManualInteractionRequiredEvent` is emitted for notification(s) to be sent **Then** notification fails to be sent **And** an error is logged Error: ```log [Error] EventAggregator: NotificationService failed while processing [ManualInteractionRequiredEvent] [v4.0.15.2940] System.InvalidOperationException: Sequence contains no elements at System.Linq.ThrowHelper.ThrowNoElementsException() at System.Linq.Enumerable.First[TSource](IEnumerable`1 source) at NzbDrone.Core.Notifications.NotificationService.GetMessage(Series series, List`1 episodes, QualityModel quality) in ./Sonarr.Core/Notifications/NotificationService.cs:line 68 at NzbDrone.Core.Notifications.NotificationService.Handle(ManualInteractionRequiredEvent message) in ./Sonarr.Core/Notifications/NotificationService.cs:line 345 ``` notification for "Manual Interaction ### Expected Behavior Notification is sent successfully **Proposal:** in the event when Episode cannot be determined, fall back to `path` or a placeholder ### Steps To Reproduce _No response_ ### Environment ```markdown - OS: Docker - Sonarr: 4.0.15.2940 - Docker Install: Yes - Using Reverse Proxy: Yes - Browser: N/A - Database: Sqlite 3.49.2 ``` ### What branch are you running?
